2607.06802.title: A Multi-Analyst LLM Pipeline for Auditable Rule Discovery Across 68 Public Physiological Corpora
2607.06802.paper_summary: Open physiological corpora are heterogeneous: they use different sensors, labels, sampling rates, recording settings, and clinical endpoints. They can support detector design, but they do not directly specify which detector rules should be built for a new contactless monitoring platform. We report a controlled four-analyst large-language-model (LLM) workflow for converting 68 public physiological corpora, screened for commercial-use compatibility, into an auditable library of candidate rule shapes for prospective validation. Four independent commercial LLM families read the corpus documentation under a controlled prompt and produced 695 candidate rule markers (top-markers). Deduplication retained 649 rule records; a threshold-bounds audit then flagged 51 sanity violations for clamping or curator review. Cross-corpus consolidation produced 436 unique rule shapes. Gate-tagging against two hard invariants, native target-hardware channel availability and no multi-night per-patient personalization, identified 94 build-now detector components across four detector-family buckets. The pipeline does not produce a validated clinical detector. It produces an auditable engineering cascade in which analyst disagreement, threshold checks, curator review, and automated continuous-integration (CI) checks route literature-derived rules toward prospective hardware validation.
2607.06802.paper_summary_zh: 開放的生理數據庫是異質的：它們使用不同的傳感器、標籤、取樣率、錄製設置和臨床終點。它們可以支持探測器設計，但並不直接指定應為新的無接觸監測平台構建哪些探測器規則。我們報告了一個受控的四位分析師大型語言模型（LLM）工作流程，將68個經過篩選以適合商業使用的公共生理數據庫轉換為可審計的候選規則形狀庫，以便進行前瞻性驗證。四個獨立的商業LLM家族在受控提示下閱讀了數據庫文檔，並產生了695個候選規則標記（頂部標記）。去重保留了649條規則記錄；隨後的閾值邊界審核標記了51條理智違規，以供夾緊或策展人審查。跨數據庫整合產生了436個獨特的規則形狀。對兩個硬不變量進行門標記，即本地目標硬件通道可用性和每位患者無多夜個性化，識別出94個立即構建的探測器組件，分佈在四個探測器家族桶中。該流程不產生經過驗證的臨床探測器。它產生了一個可審計的工程級聯，其中分析師分歧、閾值檢查、策展人審查和自動化持續集成（CI）檢查將文獻衍生的規則引導向前瞻性硬件驗證。
2607.06802.author: Dovy Paukstys et.al.
